answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 12867 Country: India Title: It is correct to pray 2 rakat nafil with niyat of thanking (Shukrana) to allah for any thing good happenes or as a daily practice? Question: It is correct to pray 2 rakat nafil with niyat of thanking (Shukrana) to allah for any thing good happenes or as a daily practice? Answer ID: 12867 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1166/908=H/1430) The boons and favours from Allah pour from Allah every time in countless number. As thanks, they require us to spend our day and night in obedience of Allah and His Messenger, peace be upon him. However, there is no wrong if someone offers two rak?ah salah as thanks to Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
